summary: Error messages read as plain instructions. Sketch move, placement, mirror, copy, split, angle, joint and sweep failures now say what went wrong and what to try, and error toasts and notifications, tree diagnostics, simulation diagnostics and UI error notices round raw floating-point values and drop generated ID prefixes. Domain errors, workers, kernel runtimes and agent tools keep their exact text, and G-code, editor and controller-file panels still show source text unchanged. The part name moved from the CAD header into the part's Properties: click the part row at the top of the tree, edit Name, and Enter or leaving the field saves it. The Settings and Notifications header buttons now have the same size and quiet, borderless style as the other header controls, with the background only on hover.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Some sketch and sweep error texts changed wording; their error codes are unchanged, and agent tools still receive the exact domain text. The CAD header no longer has a Part name field; rename the part from its Properties in the tree.

checklist.schema: No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD, storage or journal schema change. Post engine API remains 1; saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event or WebMCP tool change. Renaming the part uses the existing rename-document edit with its submission, cancellation and version checks. Agent tool errors keep their exact domain messages.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change. G-code, editor and controller-artifact panels keep source text unchanged.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change.
checklist.verification: Full Vitest suite 5850/5850 in 521 files, including tests for the user-message boundary, an error notification that hides a raw float and a generated ID, a success toast that keeps its file name, and the Properties name field; tsc, oxlint (zero findings), ui:check and production build pass. Playwright CAD journeys 86/86. Independent Codex review findings fixed with regression tests: the Name field disabling itself inside the Properties fieldset, a rejected name draft left locking commands after Properties closed, rounding inside file names and quoted source text, and constraint inspection, sweep, controller-artifact and machine-package results returned to agents now keeping exact text. A final Codex pass found no further issues beyond success toasts, which now show their text unchanged.

publicNotes.summary: Clearer error messages, renaming the part from its Properties, and consistent header buttons.
changes: Errors explain what went wrong and what to try, without long raw numbers or internal IDs.
Click the part at the top of the tree to open its Properties and rename it there.
Settings and Notifications in the header match the other header buttons.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions, CAD files and controller output are unchanged.
